findings.current: And your parents and that little sister waiting at home…… Ah. Your father was already dead, wasn’t he?
findings.defect: The translation sanitizes both 동생 년 and 애비, losing Go Jun’s deliberately degrading and vicious register toward Taekyung’s family.
findings.rationale: 년 is a gendered insult equivalent to “bitch,” while 애비 is a contemptuous way to refer to someone’s father rather than the neutral “father.”
findings.replacement: And your parents and that bitch of a little sister waiting at home… Ah. Your old man was already dead, wasn’t he?
findings.source: 그리고 집에서 기다리고 있을 부모와 동생 년…… 아. 애비는 이미 죽고 없었나?

findings.current: Even before that, my fist had already driven deep into Go Jun’s body, engulfed in blue-white hellfire.
findings.defect: This says Taekyung’s fist has already penetrated Go Jun’s body before he throws the punch in the following paragraph, altering the attack sequence.
findings.rationale: 몸 안쪽으로 깊숙이 파고든 describes Taekyung entering deep inside Go Jun’s defensive range; the actual strike into his solar plexus occurs only afterward.
findings.replacement: Before they even fell, my fist was already deep inside Go Jun’s guard, wreathed in blue-white hellfire.
findings.source: 그보다 먼저 석고준의 몸 안쪽으로 깊숙이 파고든 내 주먹은 청백색의 겁화에 휩싸여 있었다.

findings.defect: “Ptooey” conventionally depicts someone deliberately spitting, but the sound accompanies a fountain of blood erupting involuntarily from Go Jun’s mouth.
findings.rationale: The Korean sound effect represents the forceful spray of the blood fountain described immediately before it, not a deliberate spit.

findings.current: A thin line appeared across my exposed skin, then began to glow red.
findings.defect: The draft adds luminescence absent from the source.
findings.rationale: 붉은 빛을 띠었다 means the cut took on a red color; it does not say that it emitted light.
findings.replacement: A thin line appeared across my exposed skin, then turned red.
findings.source: 훤히 드러난 맨살 위로 미세한 실선이 그어지고, 이내 붉은 빛을 띠었다.

findings.current: At the end of the direction in which I shot like a beam of light, leaving the thunderous roar behind me, stood a monster that had willingly abandoned its humanity.
findings.defect: “At the end of the direction in which I shot” is an unnatural spatial calque that obscures the otherwise straightforward charge toward Go Jun.
findings.rationale: 그 방향의 끝에 identifies the monster at the end of Taekyung’s path; the replacement preserves that image in natural action prose.
findings.replacement: I shot forward like a beam of light, leaving the thunderous boom behind me. At the end of my path stood a monster that had willingly abandoned its humanity.
findings.source: 굉음을 뒤로하고 빛살처럼 쏘아진 그 방향의 끝에, 스스로 인간이길 포기한 괴물이 있었다.

findings.defect: “Magical power” fails to convey the explicit distinction between ordinary mana and the corrupted, ominous 魔力 being identified here.
findings.rationale: The preceding sentences define this energy as the corrupted opposite of pure mana, and the source supplies the characters 魔力 to foreground its demonic nature.

findings.current: A collection of qi with terrifying destructive and cutting power blocked the attack.
findings.defect: The grammatical subject is reversed: the draft says the destructive energy blocks something else, whereas the source says that energy is itself blocked by the summoned armor. Calling Go Jun’s corrupted energy “qi” also blurs the established energy distinction.
findings.rationale: 가로막힌다 is passive: the concentrated energy at Go Jun’s sword tip is stopped, with the next sentence revealing the Fire Dragon Armor as the barrier.
findings.replacement: The mass of energy, packed with terrifying destructive and cutting power, was blocked.
findings.source: 무시무시한 파괴력과 절삭력을 지닌 기의 집합체가 가로막힌다.

findings.current: The reason I had refused to bring out the Fire Dragon Armor even after breaking through to the top floor and suffering a minor wound to my chest was for a moment like this—one I could not afford to overlook.
findings.defect: “One I could not afford to overlook” does not express 혹시 모를, which means that Taekyung saved the armor as insurance against an unforeseen contingency.
findings.rationale: 혹시 모를 순간 emphasizes preparation for something unexpected, directly supporting Taekyung’s following “life insurance” joke.
findings.replacement: The reason I had kept the Fire Dragon Armor hidden all the way to the top floor—even after taking a minor wound to the chest—was to save it for an unexpected moment like this.
findings.source: 최상층까지 돌파하고 가슴에 미약한 상처를 입으면서까지 끝끝내 화룡갑을 꺼내지 않았던 이유는, 지금처럼 혹시 모를 순간을 위해서다.

summary: Two critical action/mechanism errors, three meaningful register or terminology issues, and three localized wording defects.
